tools.name: resolve_location
tools.description: Resolve a human place name before searching. Never invent a geoId.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search deterministic safe property previews and create a short-lived search session.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Read safe detail for a property returned by the same search session.

tools.name: select_property
tools.description: Record explicit interest in a property within the search session.

tools.name: start_email_verification
tools.description: Send a short-lived verification code for the search session.

tools.name: confirm_email_verification
tools.description: Confirm the code and attach a verified Globimmo user to the session.

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Persist the verified search and optionally enable email alerts.

tools.name: get_saved_search_updates
tools.description: Return new matches owned by the authenticated AI client.

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Create a pseudonymous inquiry for a returned property using a verified session.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read pseudonymous messages, lifecycle state, and contact-exchange state.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a relay message without direct contact details.

tools.name: reopen_conversation
tools.description: Reopen a previously closed conversation unless it is blocked.

tools.name: block_conversation
tools.description: Permanently block further public relay actions for this conversation.

tools.name: report_message
tools.description: Create an idempotent abuse report for a message from the other participant.

tools.name: get_contact_exchange
tools.description: Read field-level contact consent and released snapshots for the current actor.

tools.name: prepare_contact_exchange
tools.description: Offer selected contact fields and request selected fields from the other participant.

tools.name: confirm_contact_exchange
tools.description: Accept a subset of offered fields and share a subset of requested fields.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_email_verification, save_search, get_conversation · Private data: select_property, get_conversation, send_message, get_contact_exchange, prepare_contact_exchange, confirm_contact_exchange · Public sink: start_email_verification, confirm_email_verification, save_search, send_message, confirm_contact_exchange.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_email_verification, save_search, get_conversation · Private data: select_property, get_conversation, send_message, get_contact_exchange, prepare_contact_exchange, confirm_contact_exchange · Public sink: start_email_verification, confirm_email_verification, save_search, send_message, confirm_contact_exchange

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
